app.command: cargo test --release --offline --locked --target aarch64-apple-darwin --jobs 2 -p cueglint --bin cueglint calendar -- --nocapture

covered: Local-only inspection and explicit connect, refresh, reconnect, cancel and disconnect routing.
Default History shows up to three entries and only expands the loaded page. Timed entries use their UTC instant and all-day dates remain exact.
Rotation, reconnect, stale-page behavior, two-phase scoped revocation, local removal, generation retirement after restore and stale-completion rejection.
Fixture mode suppresses transport and the app launcher refuses URLs outside the expected authorization boundary.
limits: App controls run headlessly with controlled Calendar snapshots. The scripted worker uses an in-memory fake backend.
Native browser launch, live account and vault interactions, Calendar-local time rendering, reminders and additional remote pages remain open. No reference or visual match is claimed.
